full_page.content:
1928, February
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 9
Feb. 15 Ear-drum taken away - hears still. Eugene Love 5 of 5816 Belvidere mastoids lost his ear-drum and yet hears.
Margaret Mary E, Crawford Milwaukee - Father convert - consumption - only child
Baby Carroll Marie Spencer - 22 yrs - 20 convulsions in two days. Enrolled in August -- 0 K now
June Sherry - Nurse - failing in mind and nerve after training 26 months - Back now o.k. Enrolled Jan. Ist. Deo Grat.
Donahue - Cancer
Miss McDonalds Sister - Mrs. Wilson - 4 small children Arthur Cloutier - dying of Cancer . . conversion.
Rose M. Sweeney - Convultions every 2 months - gets like crazy. Mary Callahan - anxious about debts
Kenneth Kemp ... needle in knee ... O.K.
Page 10
Loss of Property.
Anna Marie Heth 21 - 6 hemorages & 1l Hemorages
Mrs. Chatterdon - non Cath. thrown out by only daughter
Mr. Griswald of Jackson - Terrible Jaw.
Marg Kent - Chicago Hospital Operated on time & again ???
Margaret Mary Schevur - little 7 year old girl Bn on Feast of S S.Cord. - hand wizened
Losing house - prayers requested F. Potuas Albert Kimpr - Needle operation OK.
